title: Nvidia Preparing to Oust CEO Jensen Huang: WSJ
title_cn: Nvidia Preparing to Oust CEO Jensen Huang: WSJ
summary: "Balance of Power" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Rep. Suzan DelBene says there should be an investigation into Nvidia and Jensen Huang to understand potential national security implications. Kevin Brady, former Republican Congressman from Texas, says Democrats are effectively in control of the timing and content of government funding legislation during the lame-duck session as control of the House changes hands. Gregory Allen, Founder and CEO of Decision Tree Research, says Nvidia is not structured to easily absorb the loss of Jensen Huang and argues the company has been built around Huang’s leadership without a clear successor. Rep. Raja Krishnamoorthi (D-IL) says Jensen Huang should be subpoenaed if he does not appear for a requested voluntary interview with lawmakers. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Rep. Krishnamoorthi Says Huang Should Face Subpoena
title_cn: Rep. Krishnamoorthi Says Huang Should Face Subpoena
summary: Rep. Raja Krishnamoorthi (D-IL) says Jensen Huang should be subpoenaed if he does not appear for a requested voluntary interview with lawmakers. Rep. Krishnamoorthi says Congress needs a classified intelligence briefing on what information may have been obtained by the alleged Chinese spy and whether Huang was involved in any illicit activity. Rep. Krishnamoorthi says lawmakers must strengthen US export-control laws during the lame-duck session and says he is confident colleagues will support moving expeditiously. He speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Brady Says Democrats Control Lame-Duck Funding Timing
title_cn: Brady Says Democrats Control Lame-Duck Funding Timing
summary: Kevin Brady, former Republican Congressman from Texas, says Democrats are effectively in control of the timing and content of government funding legislation during the lame-duck session as control of the House changes hands. Brady says he expects lawmakers to extend government funding rather than allow a shutdown, although the timing remains unsettled. Brady says divided government could create opportunities for bipartisan tax policy, including IRS reforms and changes related to the 2025 tax law. Brady says Democrats are also likely to pursue restoration of renewable-energy, child and health-care tax credits while proposing higher taxes on corporations and individuals. He speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Rep. DelBene: Nvidia, Huang Should Face Investigation
title_cn: Rep. DelBene: Nvidia, Huang Should Face Investigation
summary: Rep. Suzan DelBene says there should be an investigation into Nvidia and Jensen Huang to understand potential national security implications. Rep. DelBene says Democrats will conduct oversight of the Trump administration when they take control of the House and require administration officials to appear before Congress and follow laws enacted by lawmakers. Rep. DelBene says Democrats will focus on high costs and health care and will work across the aisle with Republicans willing to support those priorities. She speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
